description: Return the official, verified USWDS HTML for a component or page template (rendered from the official @uswds/uswds templates). Use this instead of writing usa-* markup from memory. Call with no arguments to list everything available.

asset_path.description: URL prefix where USWDS dist assets are served (default /uswds)

component.description: Component or page-template name, e.g. accordion, button, footer, sign-in

variant.description: Variant such as bordered, slim, big, outline, error

name: get_component_markup
title: Get Canonical USWDS Markup
